newsitem.title: UK: Barclays to report profit fall at BZW-paper.
newsitem.headline: Barclays to report profit fall at BZW-paper.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Bank is set to surprise the the market with news of a profits collapse, The Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.
The newspaper said some analysts are expecting operating profits at BZW to be a third lower at about 190 million stg.
However, the group's retail bank is expected to have made record profits and some analysts are predicting it to launch another buy back of up to 400 million stg.
BZW last year increased operating profits by 18 percent to 286 million stg.
